scoringCalibration: One mouth-detail point is earned for replacing the exposed crescent lip sheets with continuous rounded upper and lower surfaces and adding explicit oral-cavity, upper-teeth and tongue layers. The retained Multires body still lacks expression-compatible lip loops and an actual deformable mouth opening.
visualFindings: The upper vermilion now has a controlled cupid bow and the lower lip has a continuous rounded volume.
The former black crescent caps and ragged wet-line silhouette are absent in frontal and three-quarter close renders.
The neutral mouth closes cleanly while the cavity, teeth and tongue remain explicit head-bound engine-owned layers for later expression work.
rejectedExperiments: A vertex-alpha mouth opening was rejected because the retained coarse Multires base exposed large triangular holes.
The first oral-layer placement was rejected because isolated teeth and cavity side walls became visible and intersected posed skin.
A closed replacement lip volume was rejected because its rear caps appeared as dark corner crescents.
blockingFailures: The body needs expression-compatible lip loops and a deformable mouth opening before teeth and tongue can be exposed during speech.
Integrated upper and lower eyelid thickness and expression-compatible canthus topology remain below review quality.
The primary groom still needs hand-shaped large and medium clumps, a readable part, crown breakup and controlled side volume.
Clothing edge flow, seams, folds, materials and outer layers remain below review quality.
Raised-arm shoulders still require corrective deformation and the standard pose suite remains incomplete.
Signed clothing-distance samples remain negative despite zero exact triangle overlaps in the audited frames.
LOD transition popping and frame-time impact remain untested in the website renderer.
